description: Fallout4.ini starts with a UTF-8 BOM, which is kept as U+FEFF, so '[General]' isn't a header and sLanguage lands under NO-SECTION: the language is English (INI-3, INI-4, B-14, T-1).

deviations.reason: The port reads game INIs with a UTF-8 BOM stripped, falls back to Windows-1252 for non-UTF-8 bytes, and trims lines, keys and values.
